ns2:course.label: Thermodynamics
ns2:course.description: Fundamental concepts and the laws of thermodynamics; the first and second law applications to phase equilibrium and chemical equilibrium and other applications in the Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering profession. Credit is not given toward graduation for CHBE 321 and either ABE 340 or ME 200. Prerequisite: CHBE 221 and MATH 241.
